#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn brief_respects_budget() {
        let events = fixture_events("room_busy.json");
        let out = build_brief(&events, BRIEF_DEFAULT_MAX);
        assert!(estimate_tokens(&out) <= BRIEF_DEFAULT_MAX, "brief too long: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn truncation_drops_done_tasks_first() {
        let mut events = fixture_events("room_busy.json");
        events.retain(|e| e.kind != Kind::Chat);
        let out = build_brief(&events, 80);
        assert!(!out.contains("[done]"));
    }
}
